# {{ site.author }} (muhamed.at)

> Personal site of {{ site.author }}: Ruby/Rails engineer and AI product developer, core contributor to enola and maintainer of four related gems, creator of pi-brain, organizer of RubyConf Austria (and EuRuKo 2024 before it). The site has two content sections: a raw, AI-assisted "brain stream" of notes and links, and longer human-written essays under "writing". It also describes consulting and training services for AI-augmented development.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. All pages are static HTML and easy to fetch. Feeds carry full content. The complete text of every page is available in one fetch at {{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt.

## Key pages

- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): bio, career history, specialties, open source work
- [Services]({{ site.url }}/services/): consulting, workshops, and fractional AI product engineering for Rails teams
- [Writing]({{ site.url }}/writing/): longer essays, written by a human
- [Brain stream]({{ site.url }}/): short notes on what I am reading and building, organized with AI assistance
- [Tags]({{ site.url }}/tags/): tag index across both sections
- [Politika]({{ site.url }}/politika/): public-record election projects, currently [Izbori 2026]({{ site.url }}/politika/analiza-izbora/), a plain-language voter guide to the 2026 general election in Bosnia and Herzegovina (in Bosnian, roughly 7,300 static pages, own sitemap at {{ site.url }}/politika/analiza-izbora/sitemap.xml)

## Feeds

- [Writing feed]({{ site.url }}/feed.xml): Atom feed of essays
- [Brain stream feed]({{ site.url }}/brain.xml): Atom feed of the brain stream
- [Sitemap]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml)

## Open source

- [pi-brain](https://github.com/misabegovic/pi-brain): a cloneable, agent-maintained knowledge base; this site runs on a clone of it
- [enola](https://github.com/enola-labs/enola): architectural regression testing for AI-assisted development (core contributor; contributions include the constraints program, the fact-provider seam, the blame/diff history store, declared intent, Ember support, the Rails extraction work, and the Ruby DSL for laws)
- [enola](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola): pure-Ruby wrapper gem for the enola architecture intelligence binary (maintainer)
- [enola-rb](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola-rb): the Rails layer for enola (maintainer)
- [enola-guides](https://rubygems.org/gems/enola-guides): the content layer for enola, guides and law catalogue (maintainer)
- [munola](https://rubygems.org/gems/munola): a personal channel on top of enola with a built-in recipe catalogue (maintainer)
